label: Act is SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 to POTENCY_2 at a first being, from composition
meaning: The first-being version of act priority from the same five premises: by firstBeingNoPotencyOfComposition a first being is in potency in no respect, so the first-being version holds vacuously. Each of the five premises is needed (Control.CompositionOmissions). The proof applies each premise only at a supposed first being; no premise says that an idle potency of a being other than a first one has a prior being in act. Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.

strong_version_needed.3d99779b-b44a-4daa-a873-8ccdd3c034ae: The route takes act in some respect (STMT 8288ff1e), not act in being; the restriction to act in being suffices only with STMT-ACTUALITY-ONLY-INSOFAR-AS-BEING or the Theta.8 incorruptibility premise, which this route does not assume (see firstBeingNoPotencyOfThetaEight).
